mapper.select: SELECT id, template_id, permission_item_id, created_at FROM role_template_permission WHERE template_id = #{templateId} ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT pi.id, pi.code, pi.name, pi.module, pi.type FROM role_template_permission rtp JOIN permission_item pi ON pi.id = rtp.permission_item_id WHERE rtp.template_id = #{templateId} ORDER BY pi.module, pi.type, pi.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO role_template_permission (template_id, permission_item_id, created_at) VALUES (#{templateId}, #{permissionItemId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))
